lines.text: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High,
for they did not keep His decrees.
They turned back and were faithless like their fathers,
They enraged Him with their high places
and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
On hearing it, God was furious
He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh,
the tent He had pitched among men.
He delivered His strength to captivity,
and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
He surrendered His people to the sword
because He was enraged by His heritage.
and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
His priests fell by the sword,
but their widows could not lament.

pictures.scene: Andrei Ryabushkin, A Moscow Street on a Holiday — the people settled in their own streets and keeping the day, He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents, but they tested and disobeyed God Most High
pictures.name: pd_ryabushkin_moscow_street_holiday

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, As the Old Sing, So Pipe the Young — the elders teaching the children the very thing they should not learn, for they did not keep His decrees, they turned back and were faithless like their fathers
pictures.name: pd_steen_as_the_old_sing

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Arcadian or Pastoral State — the people at ease in the valley with the altar smoking on the high ground above, twisted like a faulty bow, they enraged Him with their high places
pictures.name: pd_cole_arcadian_pastoral_state

pictures.scene: Jacques Ignatius de Roore, De afgoderij van Jerobeam — the king bowing down the whole nation before the thing he has set up, and provoked His jealousy with their idols, on hearing it God was furious
pictures.name: pd_deroore_afgoderij_van_jerobeam

pictures.scene: Anthonie de Lorme, Interior of the Laurenskerk in Rotterdam — the great church standing swept and empty with no one in it, and rejected Israel completely, He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh
pictures.name: pd_delorme_laurenskerk_rotterdam

pictures.scene: Sebastiano del Piombo, Cristo con la cruz a cuestas — the Lord who pitched His tent among men carrying the beam Himself, the tent He had pitched among men, He delivered His strength to captivity
pictures.name: pd_piombo_cristo_cruz

pictures.scene: Ernest Meissonier, 1807, Friedland — the whole weight of the cavalry thrown forward past the emperor, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary, He surrendered His people to the sword
pictures.name: pd_meissonier_friedland

pictures.scene: Francisco Goya, La fragua — the young men standing into the hammer over the open fire, because He was enraged by His heritage, fire consumed His young men
pictures.name: pd_goya_la_fragua

pictures.scene: Evaristo Baschenis, Strumenti musicali — the instruments laid down with the dust settling on them and nobody playing, and their maidens were left without wedding songs, His priests fell by the sword
pictures.name: pd_baschenis_strumenti_musicali

pictures.scene: Giovanni Lanfranco, Elijah Awakened by the Angel — the sleeper touched and raised up to stand again, but their widows could not lament, then the Lord awoke as from sleep
pictures.name: pd_lanfranco_elia_gewekt
